phone.changelog: v3.4.0: Scan-to-pair — Remote tab QR scanner connects to your TV instantly. New unified design (Space Grotesk/Inter, teal AJO accent). Update checker fixed: removed a mirror that served stale manifests, so update banners arrive reliably.

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.92: Update checker fixed — removed a stale-caching mirror that could hide update banners. Carries v3.12.91: pairing QR deep link for AJO Phone scan-to-cast.
